issuer: CSDD (Ceļu satiksmes drošības direkcija, the Road Traffic Safety Directorate)
note: Read 2026-11-03 on likumi.lv (the official legal acts portal, which had reset every connection on 2026-10-31). The Road Traffic Law (Ceļu satiksmes likums), as amended to the law of 14 May 2026: art. 24(1)(3), eighteen for a category B licence; art. 22(2), an AM, A1, A2, A, B, B1 or BE licence is valid ten years. The Cabinet Regulations No. 103 (2010) on getting a licence, read the same day, set no shorter first licence for B. The CSDD's price list (Cabinet Regulations No. 1000 of 2013, Appendix 2 as worded by Regulations No. 65 of 17 February 2026): item 31, preparing and issuing a driver's document for holders of Latvian and other EU documents, €5.42; item 33, the licence itself, €16.99 with VAT. The two are held together as €22.41, as Albania's two payments are. The tests and the medical aren't held. No identity card and no exchange list were read.
